description: This file declares the IpcClient class and related accessor class within the firebolt::rialto::client namespace. It defines the interface for an IPC client, including methods for creating channels, closures, and controllers, as well as managing the IPC thread and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: IpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to an IIpcClient instance, implementing the IIpcClientAccessor interface.

classes.name: IpcClient
classes.description: Implements the IIpcClient interface, managing IPC communication, thread lifecycle, and connection management.

methods.name: IpcClientAccessor::getIpcClient
methods.description: Returns a reference to the associated IIpcClient instance.

methods.name: IpcClient::IpcClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC client with channel, controller, and closure factories.

methods.name: IpcClient::~IpcClient
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the IPC client.

methods.name: IpcClient::getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the IPC channel.

methods.name: IpcClient::createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates and returns a new blocking closure.

methods.name: IpcClient::createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RPC controller.

methods.name: IpcClient::processIpcThread
methods.description: Main loop for processing IPC communication in a separate thread.

methods.name: IpcClient::connect
methods.description: Establishes connection between the Rialto server and client.

methods.name: IpcClient::disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection between the Rialto server and client.
